notes: The brief v06, C.tex, H.tex, C_alerts.md, PREAMBLE.tex, notation_snapshot.md, and source_paths.json were read before image inspection. Only scan007 source images and this reader's own outputs were accessed. No other reader material, other scan image, records directory, OCR, recognition software, PDF text layer, external research, or delegation was used.

Timing: start_utc is the first captured clock reading, taken immediately after the initial brief and packet reads. Those reads had begun before that timestamp; their exact earlier start was not captured. Every listed view timestamp is an actual clock observation immediately before the corresponding image-view call. The whole page and the two supplied halves were each viewed once, in the required order. Every crop was viewed once; no settled locus was recropped.

Coverage statement: every text block, every word and ending, punctuation, accent, quote, abbreviation, inline formula, display term, operation sign, index, source cancellation, insertion, underline and visible page number was compared against both witnesses, including agreements. The formula coverage in notation is a visual transcription record, separate from mathematical proof checks.

The page is a typescript with pen corrections in an unnamed hand and a separate pencil archive number. The packet does not establish the identity of the correcting hand. No title, date, author page numeral, diagram, or independent drawing is visible. The lower-left 6 is recorded only as archive metadata; H's page 6 already carries that number, so it is not counted as an omission.

The opening ent is an incomplete continuation on this page. Real line-division hyphens were joined within the page, including pressent, homótopique, projectifs, tensoriel, évidemment, distributivité, and faire. The incomplete cancelled Picar is not completed to Picard. The cancelled str is not expanded to structure or another word.

Several H differences are already settled in the prescribed halves and therefore have no reader crop: la notion, de, the short underline in commune, both pairs of quotation marks, and cancelled avec. Their changes rows explicitly identify that evidence so the main reader can make its own required adjudication crops.

The ordinary live lettering and the display agree broadly with both witnesses. The most consequential proposed new cancelled readings are de beneath plus, or beneath the ro of projectifs, and str beneath loi. These are based on surviving component strokes. Overprinting does not itself expose a timestamp for each impression; the old/live assignment is a diplomatic reading of the corrected words, not a measured impression sequence.

The line under strictes extends below its comma. The small line in commune is under u alone. The long stroke under handwritten ordinaire and the curved stroke at suivante. are insertion connectors attached at their insertion points; neither is represented as a detached diagram or drawing.

The acute in homótopique is physically separate from the overwritten first syllable. The isolated cross-like spot farther right has no secure character value and remains an image-status doubt, recorded in a source comment rather than silently supplied as a typographic symbol.

The upper paragraph describes anticipated close relations among n-categories, infinity-categories, simplicial objects, topological objects, and strict Picard categories, and speaks prospectively of a fusion of three algebraic viewpoints. Its conditional wording is retained.

The second paragraph proposes studying categories with sum and tensor operations, a distributivity datum and suitable compatibilities. It then states that pi_0(A) is a commutative unital ring and pi_1(A) a module, and asks which further invariants characterize A up to equivalence preserving the structures. These are statements encountered in transcription, not proofs performed by this reader.

No mathematical proof, independent re-proof, algebraic computation, or formal certificate was performed. The exact factors and signs in the distributivity display and the final invariant indices were visually checked only; math_checks is therefore empty.
